**Two C# files in this repository contain the literal string `GracePeriodTime`** (based on what my code-index tools can search — see the caveat below):

1. `src/OrderProcessor/BackgroundTaskOptions.cs` — declares the property: `public int GracePeriodTime { get; set; }` (`src/OrderProcessor/BackgroundTaskOptions.cs:5`).
2. `src/OrderProcessor/Services/GracePeriodManagerService.cs` — uses the string three times inside `GetConfirmedGracePeriodOrders()`: as the SQL parameter placeholder `@GracePeriodTime` in the query text, as the parameter name in `command.Parameters.AddWithValue("GracePeriodTime", TimeSpan.FromMinutes(_options.GracePeriodTime))`, and as the options property read (`src/OrderProcessor/Services/GracePeriodManagerService.cs:44-95`, method body shown at the file's tail; the class itself starts at `src/OrderProcessor/Services/GracePeriodManagerService.cs:8`).

How I established this: I searched the analyzed symbol graph for `GracePeriodTime`/`GracePeriod`/`Grace`, which surfaced `GracePeriodManagerService`, `BackgroundTaskOptions`, and the `GracePeriodConfirmedIntegrationEvent` types, then read each one's source. The only other `GracePeriod*` code files — `src/OrderProcessor/Events/GracePeriodConfirmedIntegrationEvent.cs`, `src/Ordering.API/Application/IntegrationEvents/Events/GracePeriodConfirmedIntegrationEvent.cs` and `.../EventHandling/GracePeriodConfirmedIntegrationEventHandler.cs` — do not contain the literal `GracePeriodTime`, only `GracePeriodConfirmed*`.

**Important caveat — I could not search non-C# files.** My tools only index C#/source symbols; a config-key scan (`config`) covers only literal keys used in C# via `IConfiguration` indexers/`GetValue`/`GetSection`, and it lists 16 keys, none of them `GracePeriodTime`. The options object is bound by section name via `builder.Services.AddOptions<BackgroundTaskOptions>().BindConfiguration(nameof(BackgroundTaskOptions))` (`src/OrderProcessor/Extensions/Extensions.cs:15-16`), which strongly implies a JSON settings file (e.g. `src/OrderProcessor/appsettings.json`) supplies a `BackgroundTaskOptions:GracePeriodTime` value — but I was unable to open or verify any `.json`/`.yaml`/`.env` file, so I cannot confirm or rule out additional occurrences outside C# source.
